details: Hi! I would like to request a feature for non index users about how gestures with normal controllers works, example oculus touch, If you take for just an example Half Life Alxy or NeosVR, you are more free to do gestures, and you are not locked to do more at the same time, like you can keep moving your index finger and thumbstick positions works and also if you are resting your finger in the trackpad/buttons etc. At the same time, the index finder (trigger) can detect the pressure. I was thinking about if it is possible to make a system that would allow us to use the same animations, while being able to do the same gestures and detecting the pressure on the grip, and thumbsticks positions or buttons being pressed making the thumb move to it you can keep moving your index finger and thumbstick positions works and also if you are resting your finger in the trackpad/buttons etc. At the same time, the index finder (trigger) can detect the pressure.
